domains.definition: A recurring service arrangement (scheduled maintenance visits) covering one or more General Maintenance services, as opposed to booking one visit at a time. Not yet an approved commercial product — treated as an enquiry-capture flow, not an order flow.
domains.whatAIMaySay: The four named services are approved and available across all 7 emirates. The company can record interest in a recurring plan for Owner review — framed as an enquiry, not an active offer.
whatAIMustNotSay: That a maintenance contract is available now to sign up

domains.definition: A recurring cleaning arrangement (daily/weekly/bi-weekly/monthly) as opposed to a single one-off booking. No packaged recurring-cleaning product is approved yet — enquiry-capture flow only.
domains.whatAIMaySay: General Cleaning, Deep Cleaning, Villa Cleaning, and Office Cleaning are approved and available across all 7 emirates. General and Deep Cleaning are distinct scopes — ask which the customer needs.
whatAIMustNotSay: Any staffing claim (same cleaner every visit, vetting claims)
That a cleaning contract is available now to sign up

domains.definition: A recurring preventive/periodic treatment arrangement under the single SVC-PEST-CONTROL service — a cadence question, not a multi-service bundle. Enquiry-capture flow only.
domains.whatAIMaySay: Pest Control (inspection, treatment, elimination, prevention) is approved and available across all 7 emirates for residential/commercial/industrial/government customers.
whatAIMustNotSay: Any response-time commitment for active infestations
